title: Oil Tops $100 on Supply Fears,  Apple Faces a Big Test
description:
Get a jump start on the US trading day with Vonnie Quinn and Bailey Lipschultz on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Scott Bessent turns up the heat on global markets, from the yen to Treasuries. Brent crude breaks above $100 as fresh Middle East attacks stoke supply fears. Apple faces sky-high expectations ahead of its biggest event in years. Plus, Vale CFO Marcelo Bacci on resilient iron ore demand, and Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon exits with a stark warning over AI risk.
